steps.thought: I will determine if the year 1972 is a leap year by checking if it is divisible by 4 and not divisible by 100 (unless it is also divisible by 400).
steps.raw_response:
Determining if 1972 is a leap year requires checking the following criteria:
1. Is the year divisible by 4? $1972 \div 4 = 493$ (Yes, it is).
2. Is it a century year (divisible by 100)? No, 1972 is not divisible by 100.
Since it is divisible by 4 and not a century year, it is a leap year.
